description: Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets (prediction markets on sports, central bank decisions, IPOs and daily BTC price contracts) over the last 4 hours, 1 day or 1 week: total volume, fills, wallets and active markets, plus the most traded outcomes with their last price (the implied probability, 0 to 1) and last-24-hour volume. Each outcome has a Yes and a No side whose prices sum to 1. For one outcome's trades or candles pass its symbol to get_recent_trades or get_candles; settled outcomes stay queryable. For per-wallet outcome activity use run_query on hl.wallet_daily with market_class = 'prediction'.

limit.description: Number of outcomes to return, most traded first (1-200, default 20)

name: get_outcome_markets

computed_at.description: When the summary was computed, Unix seconds

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

notional_total.description: Volume in USD over the window

top_markets.description: Most traded outcomes, highest 24h volume first

last_price.description: Last traded price, the implied probability (0 to 1)

notional_24h.description: Volume in USD in the last 24 hours

wallets_total.description: Wallets that traded over the window

window_hours.description: Window of the totals, in hours

title: HIP-4 outcome markets overview
